text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf is finally
about to make her Debut.

The venue was packed from morning that day.
Even though it was just a newcomer's debut, the enthusiasm
felt just like that of a graded stakes race—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, I can hear the buzz from all the way over here.
Things are really heating up even before the start."
choice_data_list: They're all voices cheering you on.
They're all voices cheering you on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I bet.
To the public, right now is when you're getting the most attention.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Bearing such an arrogant title as the "Emperor,"
just how capable is that Umamusume?
Enjoy making your wild guesses, because now's the only chance you'll get.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why today's result is critical.
Merely 'decent' would betray expectations."
choice_data_list: You're not feeling pressured, are you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Hey there, there's no need to worry.
Who do you think I am?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If anything, isn't this attention a great opportunity?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
All this excitement, even before the race.
If I demonstrate results today, people will watch us with anticipation for even greater spectacles.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
So rest easy. Or rather...
just believe in me and wait, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —From here, let us embark on our path.
